tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) of synthetic peptides, TP-5, RR-6, RR-11 and RY-11, against M. smegmatis and their 50% hemolysis concentration (HC50). Modified peptides, RR-11 and RY-11, maintained the anti-mycobacterial ability of RR-6 against RIF-susceptible M. smegmatis and RIF-resistant M. smegmatis and no hemolysis was observed at concentration of 2000 mg/L for all peptides.
